note: library = data + these rules. data/ is never edited. Each rule is mechanical, exact and counted: apply-library-fixes.mjs refuses to write unless the number of changes equals expectedCount, and source-scorecard.mjs re-applies the same rules to the originals in data/ (with separate code) and requires the result to equal library/. A change that is not listed here cannot pass gate 4.
